# Kalmly

> Kalmly is decision software for anyone who runs Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads: owners who do it themselves, in-house marketers, and ad experts who want a second opinion judged on real sales. Every morning it reads the ad account (read-only), connects the ads to real shop revenue (Wix, Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Mollie, or the business's own site), and gives one plain-language decision: scale a specific ad set, hold, change the creative, or fix a billing problem. It never edits ads; the owner does. Price: Solo €39, Grow €79 (3 ad accounts), Scale €149 (10 ad accounts) per month; two months free on yearly plans; 7-day free trial. Based in the Netherlands. Website: https://kalmly.io

## What Kalmly answers
- Which of my ad sets make money, judged on real sales divided by ad spend (not Meta's own estimates)?
- Should I raise, hold or cut a budget today, and by how much?
- Which creative (video, image, carousel, caption) is working, and what should the next one look like?
- Is a drop my problem or a Meta-wide problem today?

## Who it is for
Owners who run their own ads (tours, restaurants, shops, studios, services, events) and marketing teams at larger businesses who want every scaling decision backed by real revenue. From €10 a day to five-figure monthly budgets.

## Positioning
Meta tells you what happened. Kalmly tells you what to do.
